question: 阅读下面的短文，完成下列各题。（15小题，共22.5分） Two years ago, our class started a project to clean up a nearby river. At first, few students believed we could 1 (1)______ anything. We began by 2 (2)______ rubbish every weekend. Some of us were 3 (3)______ at how much we collected. A local company 4 (4)______ us with gloves and bags. The city government later 5 (5)______ a new rule to stop factories from dumping waste. What I learned is that change does not happen 6 (6)______. It begins with small, repeated actions. 1．A．change B．hide C．avoid D．forget 2．A．buying B．collecting C．selling D．burning 3．A．angry B．surprised C．bored D．tired 4．A．compared B．helped C．filled D．replaced 5．A．broke B．made C．lost D．copied 6．A．overnight B．slowly C．quietly D．safely
explanation: 【解析】1. change（起初很少有同学相信我们能「改变」什么）；2. collecting（每周收集垃圾）；3. surprised（对我们收集的量感到惊讶）；4. helped（当地公司「提供」帮助，help sb with sth）；5. made（政府后来「制定」新规定，make a rule）；6. overnight（变化不会「一夜之间」发生，与后文「始于细小而反复的行动」呼应）。

question: 阅读下面的短文，在空白处填入适当的内容。 Cultural heritage is not only about old buildings. It also 1 (include) ______ traditions and skills. In recent years, more young people 2 (become) ______ interested in traditional crafts. They use social media 3 (share) ______ their work. One craftsman said, "Heritage is something we use and change, so that it 4 (stay) ______ alive." This attitude 5 (be) ______ important for the future of our culture.
answer: 1. includes　2. have become　3. to share　4. stays　5. is
explanation: 【解析】1. 主语 It 为第三人称单数，一般现在时；2. 由 In recent years 可知用现在完成时，主语复数用 have；3. use sth to do sth 结构，用不定式 to share；4. so that 引导目的状语从句，从句主语 it 为第三人称单数，用 stays；5. 主语 This attitude 为第三人称单数，用 is。

subject: 英语
chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 假设你是李华，你校将举办「传统文化周」活动。请给外教 Mr. Smith 写一封邮件，邀请他参加并介绍活动内容，内容包括：①活动时间与地点；②主要活动形式；③邀请他分享本国文化。 注意：①词数100左右；②可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。（15分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Dear Mr. Smith,
　　I am writing to invite you to our school's "Traditional Culture Week", which will be held from May 10th to May 16th in the school hall.
　　During the week, there will be many activities, such as paper-cutting workshops, traditional music performances and a Chinese painting exhibition. Students will also make and share traditional food.
　　We would be honoured if you could join us and share something about your own culture. Your talk would certainly help us understand other cultures better.
　　I am looking forward to your reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①涵盖三个要点（时间地点、活动形式、邀请分享）；②语言准确、连贯；③词数100左右；④邮件格式正确。

question: 阅读下面的材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一个完整的故事。 Anna had trained for the school marathon for months. On the day of the race, she felt strong. But halfway through, she twisted her ankle and fell. The other runners passed her one by one. Paragraph 1: Anna wanted to give up. ______ Paragraph 2: When she finally crossed the finish line, no one was clapping. ______ 注意：①续写词数应为150左右；②请按如下格式作答。（25分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: Anna wanted to give up. Her ankle hurt badly and the finish line seemed impossibly far away. But then she thought of all the mornings she had got up early to train, and of her father, who had told her that finishing matters more than winning. Slowly, she stood up and began to walk, then to jog, one painful step after another.
Paragraph 2: When she finally crossed the finish line, no one was clapping. The stands were almost empty and the other runners had long gone. But her father was there, waiting alone by the line. He said nothing. He simply opened his arms and held her. At that moment, Anna understood that she had won something more important than a race.
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①两段内容合理衔接原文；②情节自然、符合逻辑；③语言丰富、句式多样；④有细节与心理描写；⑤字数150左右。

[阅读] Cultural heritage is not only about old buildings and objects. It also includes traditions, languages and skills passed down from generation to generation. In recent years, many young people in China have become interested in traditional crafts. Some learn paper-cutting; others study ancient musical instruments. Social media has helped them share their work with a wider audience. "Heritage is not something we only protect," said a young craftsman. "It is something we use and change, so that it stays alive." According to the passage, cultural heritage includes ______.（2分）
A．only old buildings
B．traditions, languages and skills
C．only modern art
D．scientific inventions
answer: B
explanation: 【解析】出处：Cultural Heritage。According to the passage, cultural heritage includes ______.

[阅读] Scientific progress often brings both benefits and challenges. The invention of the internet, for example, has made information available to billions of people, but it has also created new problems such as the spread of false information. Some researchers argue that scientists should consider the social consequences of their work, not only its technical success. Others believe that science should remain independent and that society, not scientists, should decide how discoveries are used. What most agree on is that the relationship between science and society needs constant discussion. A discovery that seems purely technical may, years later, reshape how people live and think. What problem caused by the internet is mentioned?（2分）
A．Higher costs.
B．The spread of false information.
C．Fewer books.
D．Slower communication.
answer: B
explanation: 【解析】出处：Science and Society。What problem caused by the internet is mentioned?

The city government later 5 (5)______ a new rule to stop factories from dumping waste. What I learned is that change does not happen 6 (6)______. It begins with small, repeated actions. 1．A．change B．hide C．avoid D．forget 2．A．buying B．collecting C．selling D．burning 3．A．angry B．surprised C．bored D．tired 4．A．compared B．helped C．filled D．replaced 5．A．broke B．made C．lost D．copied 6．A．overnight B．slowly C．quietly D．safely
explanation: 【解析】1. change（起初很少有同学相信我们能「改变」什么）；2. collecting（每周收集垃圾）；3. surprised（对我们收集的量感到惊讶）；4. helped（当地公司「提供」帮助，help sb with sth）；5. made（政府后来「制定」新规定，make a rule）；6. overnight（变化不会「一夜之间」发生，与后文「始于细小而反复的行动」呼应）。

question: 阅读下面的短文，在空白处填入适当的内容。 Cultural heritage is not only about old buildings. It also 1 (include) ______ traditions and skills. In recent years, more young people 2 (become) ______ interested in traditional crafts. They use social media 3 (share) ______ their work. One craftsman said, "Heritage is something we use and change, so that it 4 (stay) ______ alive." This attitude 5 (be) ______ important for the future of our culture.
answer: 1. includes　2. have become　3. to share　4. stays　5. is
explanation: 【解析】1. 主语 It 为第三人称单数，一般现在时；2. 由 In recent years 可知用现在完成时，主语复数用 have；3. use sth to do sth 结构，用不定式 to share；4. so that 引导目的状语从句，从句主语 it 为第三人称单数，用 stays；5. 主语 This attitude 为第三人称单数，用 is。

chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 假设你是李华，你校将举办「传统文化周」活动。请给外教 Mr. Smith 写一封邮件，邀请他参加并介绍活动内容，内容包括：①活动时间与地点；②主要活动形式；③邀请他分享本国文化。 注意：①词数100左右；②可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。（15分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Dear Mr. Smith,
　　I am writing to invite you to our school's "Traditional Culture Week", which will be held from May 10th to May 16th in the school hall.
　　During the week, there will be many activities, such as paper-cutting workshops, traditional music performances and a Chinese painting exhibition. Students will also make and share traditional food.
　　We would be honoured if you could join us and share something about your own culture. Your talk would certainly help us understand other cultures better.
　　I am looking forward to your reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①涵盖三个要点（时间地点、活动形式、邀请分享）；②语言准确、连贯；③词数100左右；④邮件格式正确。

question: 阅读下面的材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一个完整的故事。 Anna had trained for the school marathon for months. On the day of the race, she felt strong. But halfway through, she twisted her ankle and fell. The other runners passed her one by one. Paragraph 1: Anna wanted to give up. ______ Paragraph 2: When she finally crossed the finish line, no one was clapping. ______ 注意：①续写词数应为150左右；②请按如下格式作答。（25分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: Anna wanted to give up. Her ankle hurt badly and the finish line seemed impossibly far away. But then she thought of all the mornings she had got up early to train, and of her father, who had told her that finishing matters more than winning. Slowly, she stood up and began to walk, then to jog, one painful step after another.
Paragraph 2: When she finally crossed the finish line, no one was clapping. The stands were almost empty and the other runners had long gone. But her father was there, waiting alone by the line. He said nothing. He simply opened his arms and held her. At that moment, Anna understood that she had won something more important than a race.
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①两段内容合理衔接原文；②情节自然、符合逻辑；③语言丰富、句式多样；④有细节与心理描写；⑤字数150左右。

Some countries have banned single-use plastic bags and encouraged people to bring their own. Others have invested in recycling technology. But researchers point out that recycling alone cannot solve the problem. Reducing production and changing consumption habits are equally important. What do researchers say about recycling?（2分）
A．It alone cannot solve plastic pollution.
B．It is the only solution.
C．It is unnecessary.
D．It causes more pollution.

【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: Anna wanted to give up. Her ankle hurt badly and the finish line seemed impossibly far away. But then she thought of all the mornings she had got up early to train, and of her father, who had told her that finishing matters more than winning. Slowly, she stood up and began to walk, then to jog, one painful step after another.
Paragraph 2: When she finally crossed the finish line, no one was clapping. The stands were almost empty and the other runners had long gone. But her father was there, waiting alone by the line. He said nothing. He simply opened his arms and held her. At that moment, Anna understood that she had won something more important than a race.
